Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a skilled, analytical, and forward-thinking Senior Business Analyst with strong expertise in SQL and Data Modeling to join our team. In this role, you will act as a vital bridge between our business operations and technology teams, leveraging your data skills to transform complex business requirements into actionable, high-impact digital solutions.
 What you will do: 
 • Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into clear specifications for IT solutions.
 • Knowledge of Data Analytics, specifically reporting skills in any of the BI reporting tools
 • Experience with cloud-based data platforms Azure
 • Create and validate data models to represent business needs and ensure data integrity.
 • Analyze data, identify trends, and develop reports to support business decisions.
 • Evaluate and validate IT solutions to ensure alignment with business needs and data models.
 • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
 What you must have: 
 • Proven experience as a Business Analyst.
 • Strong data modeling skills and experience with data modeling tools.
 • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
 • Knowledge of data analysis techniques and reporting tools.
 • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
 What's in it for you: 
 • Extended compensation and benefits package
 • Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
 • A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit.
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
 • Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
 • Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
 • Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.
